name: Requests header interpretation — natural dual-demand retrospective intervention

external_demands.author: Parveshkumar2211
external_demands.requirement: case-insensitive media type matching; preserve explicit charset and existing default policy

external_demands.author: 10k11
external_demands.requirement: use text/ prefix and exact application/json instead of substring; preserve explicit charset

scope: Both already disclosed. No upstream solution diff opened, no independent prospective outcome claim. Use Requests v2.32.5 installed package only after SHA check. Research interventions, not upstream patches.
arms: LOCAL: normalize media type in get_encoding_from_headers after explicit charset branch; correct predicate in same function
PARSER: normalize media token inside _parse_content_type_header; correct predicate in caller
POLICY: add single pure classification helper for canonical token and correct classification there; raw parser unchanged
design: Run both sequences of known Dcase and Dboundary, with separate stage-specific oracle preserving all non-target outputs on declared domain. Include old published test vectors, direct utility, adapter build_response and direct raw-parser projection. Raw-token preservation is analyst-selected additional contract, not upstream guarantee; report baseline parity and old tests separately.

predictions.local: both demands pass both sequences; raw parser stays exactly equal
predictions.parser: both demand outputs pass; mixed-case raw-parser projection changes only if case normalization applied; all existing lower-case tests pass
predictions.policy: same target outputs and raw parser; added helper overhead and edit footprint; no asserted performance superiority
predictions.competitor: minimal local edit strong rival; no novel-law or strict architecture reversal anticipated under default rights

cost: Report changed source files, functions, inserted/deleted lines, new helper, Q vector independently. No labor inference. Stage test cross-product finite, no full upstream suite or network.
stop: If bytes differ, abort before treatments. Any target mismatch or old official fixture regression retained. Raw parser is private; direct protection is sensitivity, not necessarily production contract.
